menu.title: 🎬 Video to Circle Bot Send a video — I'll turn it into a Telegram video note (circle). Choose a section:
info.text: 🎬 How to use 1. Send a video (file, video note or video document). 2. Wait for the conversion. 3. Get your circle. 📋 Formats: mp4, mov, avi, mkv, webm, flv, wmv, 3gp, ts, mts, vob and 30+ more (via ffmpeg). ⚙️ Telegram limits: the note is square, up to ~60 seconds, H.264/AAC codecs.
help.text: ℹ️ Help What the bot does: converts videos into Telegram video notes. Commands: /start — main menu /help — this help /setlanguage — change language Plans: • Free — basic quality, daily limit • Pro — higher quality, bigger limits Open “💳 Subscription” for details. 🔒 Privacy: the bot works in private chats only.
